name: Batch Plugin
description: Processes batches, cron tasks, queues and drush batches via simple plugins.
project_description: Batch API, Cron jobs and queues, and Drush queues are three different ways to process large amounts of data in Drupal, each requiring quite a lot of hassle and boilerplate to achieve something that should be simple. Batch Plugin is a single abstraction over all of them: you write one plugin (implementing setupOperations() to build a list of serializable payloads, and processOperation() to handle each one) and run it unchanged via Batch API, Cron, a queue, or a Drush queue. The processor that runs a batch plugin is itself a plugin, so custom processors can be added. Batch plugins can be configurable (their own plugin config form), driven from the UI via the batch_plugin_entity sub-module, or embedded elsewhere using the batch_plugin_config Form API element. Operations can be appended during processing to support nested/recursive batches, and a persistable data array carries serializable state between operations. The batch_plugin_example sub-module ships four demonstration plugins.
